replies.author: ProfessorUtonium
replies.body:
Hello Cordena.

Firstly, You did not "spam like 3 times". You decided to spam "ALLAHU ACKBAR" 15+ times in the Lobby after the match has ended. This would have been only a kick but looking back to your history, You need some time out and to reread the rules (http://avicus.net/rules). Please make sure you fully understand the rules and not get 5 Punishments in a week. Remember that if you get 10 punishments within the timeframe of 8 months, you will be banned for a month. Please fix your behavior before logging back onto the server in 3 days.

Sincerely,
ProfessorUtonium

note: appeal will be open for 24 hours for your response.
